svg.title: Let N = | box(macroR)|, m = |PlaqAxes|, q = L4. Macro-sum Cauchy–Schwarz costs Nm. For each fixed offset z, the map (x, p) 7→(wrap z + embed(x), p) from coarse site and plaquette type is injective, so summing squares costs at most the full fine sum; summing offsets adds N. Each coarse site has q children and four outgoing fine axes. Square the local link estimate using (a + b)2 ≤2a2 + 2b2. Therefore X e ∥we∥2 ≤β X p ∥curl(w)p∥2 + γ X b ∥probe(w)b∥2, β = 8C2qN 2m, γ = 2q.
